[Act: pocso
 Chapter: Miscellaneous
 Section: 39::Guidelines for child to take assistance of experts, etc.
]


Subject to such rules as may be made in this behalf, the State Government shall prepare guidelines for use of non-governmental organisations, professionals and experts or persons having knowledge of psychology, social work, physical health, mental health and child development to be associated with the pre-trial and trial stage to assist the child. 08-2019).
